correctness.rationale: Using Petersen graph KG(5,2), max induced component size defines a genuinely nested ten-stage simplicial filtration. Independently enumerated all 1024 ten-bit subsets. Exact nonempty face counts for r=1..9 are 75,260,380,510,702,857,967,1012,1022; r=10 is the full 9-simplex. Reconstructed all specified vertex-order toggle matchings and checked acyclicity by topological sorting every oriented Hasse cover. Critical cells are one vertex and one positive degree except r=4; the exception has fifteen degree-3 and four degree-4 critical cells. Independent integral matched-boundary elimination reproduces the exact displayed 15x4 matrix, and its rows 2,4,9,13 yield unimodular determinant +1; 2-connected CW and integral degree-3 basis changes cancel four 3/4 pairs giving a wedge of eleven S3, not merely Betti ranks. Rebuilt complete augmented GF2 persistence matrix, obtaining bars (dim,birth,death;mult) (2,1,2;4), (3,2,5;1), (3,4,5;10), (4,5,6;61), (5,6,7;74), (6,7,8;36), (7,8,9;9), (8,9,10;1). All calculations are exhaustive for Petersen only.
residual_risks: Homotopy classification is nonequivariant and stagewise; no filtered-space wedge equivalence; persistence specifically GF2, not integral, and no general Kneser/cubic graph theorem.
